title: Pandora's Cosmic Release
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a woman with long green braids holding a glowing red orb while standing before a massive dark blue phoenix-like bird with fiery eyes and an orange orb in its beak. The banner 'PANDORA' floats between them as red skeletal figures with dripping blood stand in the foreground below a balcony where two ornate figures observe the scene.
